subject.title: feat(ios): add Apple Watch voice turns

question: After the queue/i18n/changelog blockers and real Watch proof are addressed, should OpenClaw land a turn-scoped Apple Watch spoken-reply mode?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing Watch audio behavior with a protected maintainer label, so code review can identify blockers but cannot decide whether this becomes a supported Watch UX surface.

options.title: Sponsor after blockers and proof
options.body: Fix the review findings, add real Watch simulator or device proof of dictated input and spoken reply, then review the feature for merge.

options.title: Defer Watch spoken replies
options.body: Keep Watch chat text-only for now and leave the linked issue open or closed by maintainer decision when Watch audio is not a near-term surface.

options.title: Fold into broader Talk direction
options.body: Require a cross-device Talk design before accepting Watch-side speech playback as a standalone feature.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after blockers and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the review findings, add real Watch simulator or device proof of dictated input and spoken reply, then review the feature for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the issue and PR and have recent current-path WatchApp history, making them the clearest product-direction owner from the evidence.
